title: Microsoft Teams: keypad consent for recording and transcription in one-to-one PSTN calls
summary: The briefing's controls and planned rollout are supported, and it accurately reports the conflicting consent and audit documentation. The summary should explicitly limit keypad prompts to calls requiring consent, and licensing should distinguish existing Teams Phone entitlement from unpublished feature-specific terms.

claims.quote: PSTN participants in applicable one-to-one Teams calls where explicit consent for recording or transcription is required
claims.fix: Replace the summary with: "Where explicit consent is required, PSTN callers in one-to-one Teams calls will press 1 or 2 before recording or transcription includes them. No new setting; prepare users."

claims.claim: The consent setting is in Teams admin center > Voice > Calling policies > policy > Edit > Require participant agreement for recording and transcription.

claims.where: controls[1]; Why it matters; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft documents no separate PSTN-only or keypad-only admin UI or API consent switch.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams calling policy PSTN only keypad consent switch ExplicitRecordingConsent roles admin. Opened teams-calling-policy, call-recording-transcription-captions and Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy; these document the shared consent setting, not a separate switch.

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Voice > Calling policies > policy > Cloud recording for calling controls recording of one-to-one and PSTN calls.
claims.quote: select Voice > Calling policies. ... Select the policy that you want to edit. ... Turn Cloud recording for calling to On.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowCloudRecordingForCalls $true enables recording for the global calling policy.
claims.quote:
For example, this script enables call recording for the global policy:
Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowCloudRecordingForCalls $true

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Voice > Calling policies > policy > Transcription controls call transcription.
claims.quote: select Voice > Calling policies. ... Select the policy you want to modify. ... Turn Transcription to On.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscriptionForCalling $true enables transcription for the global calling policy.
claims.quote:
For example, this script enables transcription for the global policy:
Set-CsTeamsCallingPolicy -Identity Global -AllowTranscriptionForCalling $true

claims.fix: Set licensing.model to "included". Replace licensing.notes and the licensing paragraph with: "The capability extends existing Teams Phone calling policies. Teams Phone licensing and a PSTN solution are required for Teams PSTN calling; feature-specific licensing or a meter for this keypad extension is not yet published." Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/teams-phone-licensing. Replace "Treat licensing as not yet published rather than as included" with "Feature-specific terms remain unpublished; the existing Teams Phone entitlement is documented." In the cost rationale replace "its licensing is not yet published" with "feature-specific licensing is not yet published". Replace "Will any licence apply?" with "Will Microsoft publish feature-specific licensing terms?"
